props.text: A company does not need one more piece of software. It needs an operating system so every piece speaks the same language.

Three digital factories build the system: Ebig Tool draws interfaces and design tokens, Ebig Platform models processes, Ebig Module packages reusable features. All three read one metadata layer and one Ebig Database core, so a change in one place moves through the whole system.

items.label: the design factory — interfaces and design tokens
the data core — a single source of truth

props.title: Applications built from metadata
props.description: Interfaces, processes, and data constraints are declared as metadata instead of hard-coded. A changed requirement means editing the declaration and shipping, not rewriting and waiting for another development cycle.

items.label: the standard responsive grid in Ebig Platform
design tokens shared across every application
dynamic expression binding, with no code changes

props.title: Data moves on events
props.description: An event-driven architecture pushes every change from one department to the next the moment it happens. No data silos, and no month-end reconciliation across disconnected spreadsheets.

items.label: every change is an event travelling through the system
central state, with interfaces updating themselves
one source of truth for every department

props.title: Infrastructure wherever you want it
props.description: Cloud native when you need to scale fast, on-premise when the data has to stay in the building. The same system and the same modules — only the location differs, and moving does not mean rebuilding.

items.label: cloud native deployment that scales with load

props.title: See the system running in 30 minutes
props.note: Runs on sample data from your industry. Nothing to install.
